column2: (Everything hurts... my whole body...)
(A dull ache runs 　through every inch of me...)
(Under a faint wave of nausea, 　the back of my skull throbs...)
(My arms and legs are dead numb... 　They won't do a single thing 　I tell them...)
(No strength left in me at all...)
(B-But still... even so... 　why is my body this heavy...!?)
(What in the world... 　..has happened.. to my body...)
(Yesterday I was... 　...wait... huh!?)
(And today, what was... 　..............??)
(No. Hold on a second.)
(Come to that, I'm...)
(Who am I!?)
Oh, thank goodness—!
Honestly...
I was starting to think you'd never wake up again!
Because—because... you've been burning with $$高熱$$, in bed for over $$十ヶ月$$!
Huh...? What's wrong? Does something still hurt?!
Don't tell me... you've forgotten who I am?
What!? Don't tell me—yourself, too?
Tell me, what's your name...?
Yes! That's right!
Then what's my name?
Exactly!! Thank goodness, thank goodness...
This is our home, yours and mine. There's no one else here.
You were $$大ケガ$$ in an $$事故$$! $$雷$$ struck, on a day of rain...
I dressed your wounds, but you just slept and slept— I was so worried!
The $$羽$$ on your back?
You really have forgotten it all...
They grow on everyone... On you... and on me...
We'll remember it in order, together. About this $$世界$$... and about... us.
